英文第26題｜從上下文推測shrink字義

英文 / 綜合 / 綜合 · 首次出題日期：2026-11-12

分享原卷｜第26題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

Lisa Wu studies in a junior high school. The following is her report for her science class. Your Heart Name: Lisa Wu 1. Though many people think their heart is on the left side of their chest, it is right in the middle of it. 2. A woman's heart is about 230–280g, and a man's 280–340g. With age, men's hearts grow bigger, but women's shrink. 3. Your heart works day and night. It beats about 115,000 times each day. Animal Heartbeats (bpm = beat per minute) Elephants: 30 bpm; Horses: 36 bpm; Man: 75 bpm; Big dogs: 80 bpm; Cats: 160 bpm. 4. Check your pulse to see how well your heart is working. Ways to check your pulse: Find your pulse. → Count your heartbeat for 30 seconds. → Double it. 5. Your heart is very important. If it stays strong, you will live a healthy life. Ways to take care of your heart * Eat healthy food, like fish, vegetables, and fruit. * Don't smoke or drink. * Do exercise at least 150 minutes per week. * Eat less salt and cut back on sugar. * Be happy. Laugh out loud. 原卷詞註：chest 胸腔；beat 跳動；per 每一的；pulse 脈搏；double 使加倍。
What does shrink mean? (A) To become weaker. (B) To get darker. (C) To become smaller. (D) To get stronger.
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：使用者原始紀錄：26@錯題A → C；原筆跡保留於下方原卷。
(C) To become smaller.

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、找到原文對比
With age, men's hearts grow bigger, but women's shrink. 連接詞but表示轉折；前半說grow bigger（變大），後半shrink就應往相反的尺寸變化理解，即變小，選C。

二、其餘字義
A weaker是變弱、B darker是變暗、D stronger是變強，都是別的性質；此句對照的是大小，不是力量或顏色。

三、文意推測與科學限制
這題考單字，不以心臟重量推論個人健康，也不能把原報告中的「在正中央」與男女老化概括當成完整醫學規則。心臟位於兩肺間、胸骨後，整體略偏左；原文照留供閱讀，科學用語另列monitor。本題不另新增生物診斷或延伸題。

1 but提示相反方向

原句先說grow bigger，再用but接shrink。這裡比較的是尺寸變化。

2 bigger表示變大

用相同基準的幾何圖形呈現尺寸增加，只作字義示意，不冒充心臟解剖或測量。

3 shrink方向相反

shrink表示縮小，與變暗、變弱或變強不同；用圖形縮小對照理解即可。

④ 用bigger的對比推測shrink

答案C：become smaller

  • 只依本句詞義選C。原報告心臟位置與老化概括另標限制，不從這張字義圖做健康診斷。
